Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Performance-focused fork with slower one-author maintenance. Full-game/GPU breadth Unknown; parent/sibling owners retain separate scopes. LanternEngine built on bbport/shadPS4 plus launcher. Compare bbport existing ownership; do not create independent implementation based on launcher/name or version alone. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux engine+launcher built on bbport/shadPS4/Vulkan. PS4 direct CPU path documented; other hosts not established. Original data: PS4 Bloodborne CUSA03173 update1.09 own dump.
